question.text: For a first order reaction, the half-life is <math> <mrow> <mtext>10</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>mins</mtext><mtext>.</mtext></mrow> </math> How much time in minutes will it take to reduce the concentration of reactant to <math><mn>25</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi></math> of its original concentration?

solution.text:
It takes two half-lives to reduce the concentration of reactant to 25% of its original concentration.
Hence, total time taken =10+10
=20 minutes.
